basic_info.description: Step into the heart of Nob Hill and experience the unparalleled elegance of the 1220 Jones Street Penthousea residence where refined design seamlessly blends with captivating, romantic vistas and six balconies plus roof access. Perched atop Nob Hill, this extraordinary home offers panoramic views that stretch from the glittering lights of San Francisco's vibrant downtown to the serene beauty of the East Bay hills and the vast waters of the Bay. Every corner of this luxurious penthouse frames iconic sights, from the commanding presence of Coit Tower to the postcard-perfect views of the Golden Gate Bridge, embodying the very essence of San Francisco living. This exceptional city sanctuary features a private elevator entrance, leading to an expansive open living area, complete with two fireplaces, a gourmet kitchen, and wonderful indoor/ outdoor living and entertaining. With breathtaking views, architecturally stunning interiors, and an unparalleled connection to the outdoors, this penthouse is the epitome of gracious city living, floating high above the beautiful City by the Bay.
